name: fallTime
meaning: 4.12 s airborne: += g_dt in state 2 and on each push, capped at 0x5000 by ApplyGravity (0x4f608d); zeroed on floor contact (0x4f6064) and by a successful TryResize

name: rollTime
meaning: 4.12 s of growing rolls (+= g_dt in TryResize, 0x4f5fc8): the scale target is rollTime*0x233/0x14000 + 0x100, reaching 0x333 at 0x14000 (20 s) (0x4f5ad1-0x4f5af9)

name: baseRadius
meaning: half the x extent of model box 0 at scale 1.0 (0x4f5806-0x4f581b)

name: pushed
meaning: bit 0: set by each push (msg 0xA, 0x4f5b61), cleared by the next Update; when a frame passes without a push the ball falls (state 2)

name: zone
meaning: PROPERTY ZONE id list (Scn_FindIdList at 0x4f57d5): the ball only rolls and grows while its next position is inside one of these boxes (XZ test, 0x4f5ac2, 0x4f5f02); count 0 = anywhere

name: radius
meaning: current radius = baseRadius*scale >> 10 (set by TryResize, 0x4f5fb4); rolls the matrix (0x4f5b35)

name: scale
meaning: 6.10 scale (0x400 = 1.0): 0x400 at load, 0x100 after the first TryResize; drawn with Mat34s_ApplyScale (0x4f5bdd)

name: rollMatrix
meaning: orientation, Mat34s_FromEulerScaled(&rot) at load (0x4f57a5), rolled by Matrix_RollByDisplacement on each push

name: rollSound
meaning: handle of the rolling sound 0x7b (Sound_Play at 0x4f59a7), stopped when the ball stops being pushed
